newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: New boss sees Airlanka profits in a year-paper.
newsitem.headline: New boss sees Airlanka profits in a year-paper.

text.p: The new chairman of ailing Sri Lankan national carrier Airlanka believes he can turn around the airline and bring it back to profitability within a year, The Island newspaper said on Thursday.
The daily also quoted Harry Jayawardena as insisting there should be no outside interference in the company's affairs.
It said Jayawardena saw his primary task as proving national ventures could be run profitably and paying back all its loans as soon as possible, ahead of target.
Jayawardene is a director of several Sri Lankan blue chip companies, including Hatton National Bank, Distilleries Co of Sri Lanka and Lanka Milk Foods.
The newspaper quoted him as saying he had no plans to purchase the carrier, which has been earmarked for privatisation this year.
Airlanka is being restructured with the government selling off 40 percent as well as its management under a public enterprise reform programme.
